feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine on Trump's turn toward Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine John Herbst about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff heads to Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

entry.title: Mississippi AG says use of force was 'justified' in fatal shooting of toddler
entry.summary: Mississippi's Attorney General says the use of force was justified when a toddler was killed during a police shooting after a shoplifting.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: Leon Bridges reinvents his sound with new album, 'Happiness Anytime'
entry.summary: Leon Bridges has transformed since his 2015 debut album from a Sam Cooke-style crooner to a shape-shifting singer of all things from mambo to disco. His new album is called "Happiness Anytime."

entry.title: How much does pregnancy cost? Be prepared with these tips
entry.summary: The cost of having a baby is difficult to predict. The amount families pay varies widely. Here are five tips to help you prepare for the often unexpected costs of pregnancy and giving birth.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump envoy Steve Witkoff to visit Russia in hopes of ending war, Trump campaigns in North Carolina, Saudi Arabia cancels 'Davos in the Desert' due to Houthi strikes.

entry.title: Netflix holds quarterly earnings call following leadership shakeup and layoffs
entry.summary: Netflix reported its latest quarterly earnings on Tuesday. It comes as the streaming company has announced a management shakeup and layoffs of more than 1,000 employees.

entry.title: A Democrat could become governor of Alaska for the first time in over 20 years
entry.summary: Alaska has been a reliably red state but a Democrat has a chance of becoming governor.

entry.title: Actor Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
entry.summary: Actor Christina Applegate revealed she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis. NPR's A Martínez speaks with neurologist Michael Kornberg about how MS can be misdiagnosed.

entry.title: Why winning back-to-back titles is harder than ever in the NBA
entry.summary: As the NBA season tips off, the New York Knicks are setting out to accomplish what's become one of the hardest things in American professional sports — win back-to-back NBA titles.
